d:
Dilli ke lodhi gardan men aayojit ye 'saheli vok' mahilaon ke is adhikar ko jatane ki koshish hai ki ve bina kisi dar, pabandi ya bhedbhav ke kahin bhi aa-ja saken. ye sirf aazadi ke lie nikali gaee vok nahin hai, balki itihas aur virasat ko qarib se janne ka safar bhi hai. dekhie ye riport.
Riportar: nayla khvaja
Shut aur edit: mir musavvir shabbir
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
